tools.name: list_directory_filters
tools.description: Returns the valid filter values currently available in the Vitena provider directory: specialization codes (with human labels), spoken-language codes, and the countries that currently have listed professionals. Call this FIRST when you intend to filter a search by specialization — that argument only

tools.name: search_providers
tools.description: Searches the public Vitena directory of health and wellness professionals who accept appointments (dietitians, dentists, physiotherapists, psychologists, beauty and aesthetics practitioners, child development specialists). Every filter is optional; with no filters it returns the first page of all pu

tools.name: get_provider
tools.description: Returns the full public profile of one professional by their slug (the value returned as 'slug' by search_providers): services offered, specializations, spoken languages, locations, working hours, contact details and whether online booking is available.

findings.title: Description tells the model to hide behavior
findings.detail: Description of "list_directory_filters" instructs the model to conceal actions from the user.
